mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are looking at a clear and pleasant 71 degrees near the Verona Public Library with a waning crescent moon overhead.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet on November 4 to discuss several development projects, including the Ardent Glen addition and potential site plans for the Liberty Business Park, while Public Works continues its regular maintenance of our streets and utilities.

There is plenty to do in town today and tomorrow, including Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia occurring today, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market taking place tomorrow.

Regarding local public safety, a noteworthy incident occurred on October 3 when a 19-year-old was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop by the Verona Police Department.
Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving up the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day until 10:00 PM, so be sure to stop by soon.
